snippet.title: FLYON RC - RELEASE WINDOW - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Launch is planned for Summer 2026 only on Meta Quest. FLYON RC - ultimate miniature flying game for VR and Mixed Reality. Fly drones, RC planes and other aircrafts through your home or handcrafted VR arenas, master skill-based challenges and have fun with friends. Become a pilot without leaving your room.
